units.translation: The Mysians was the title of a play by Aeschylus (fr. 141–144).
to pay the pollution of the older house.
when all pollution is driven from the hearth.
not to be worn away by pollution in these nearby oracles.
such darkness of pollution has flown upon the man.
nor is there pollution on my hand.
I shuddered, I will speak (thus I corrected for eros) of this mystic rite.
Eustathius p. 440, 25 and 1965, 48 cites μυχθίζειν [to sigh] from Aeschylus (fr. 348).
The middle form of the compound is read at Pr. 743: σὺ δ᾽ αὐ κέκραγας κἀναμυχθίζει [but you cry out and groan aloud] (η M).
and the inmost Propontis. Blomfield compares the gulf of the Propontis from Apollonius Rhodius 1, 983.
with a royal offering from the innermost shrine.
fear—a cry from the innermost part rang out.
the dark recess of Hades beneath the earth rumbles.
for the echo of the clashing of bronze pierced the innermost part of the caves.
in the sunless recesses of the caves.
and you who within the house hold the wealth-rich recess.
holding the great recess of the earth.
I creep to the many-garlanded recess.
you defiled the recess with pollution (μυκόν M).

The gadfly is a kind of fly that appears in spring, which settles on the chosen cattle and bites them and drives them to madness, from which it is also called oestrus.
how greatly you blamed the mind of the young girl.
neither in spirit nor in the handling of arms blameworthy.
surely not even a god struck by desire?
surely this was not a secret gift of Orestes (thus Scholefield for ή)?
surely it does not seem necessary to take thought for safety?
did the wretched man on foot or as a sailor act foolishly in this attempt?
know that you will pay me the penalty for this folly.

I greatly fear the foolish fate of the moth. The accent in the manuscripts is sometimes μῶρος, sometimes μωρός. The grammarians mentioned in Thes. vol. 5 p. 1339 testify that the ancient Attics pronounced μῶρος.
